ko: 예수는 내 힘이요 나의 기쁨 내 참 소망
그 이름의 생명이 내 삶의 이유라
en: He is the reason that I live, cause there’s true life in His name.
Jesus is everything to me, my strength and my joy, my eternal hope

ko: 내가 사나 죽으나 그 이름을 위하여
내 모든 것 다 드리니 나를 받으소서
en: He is the reason that I live, cause there’s true life in His name.
Jesus is everything to me, my strength and my joy, my eternal hope
Lord, You alone I’ll follow to the end
Lord, You alone are to be exalted on high
All the days of my life I will sing and praise Your name and Your goodness
The power of Your great name, the eternal living God
Is the reason that I live
